title: Quanta Services Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
publisher: Quanta Services, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Second quarter revenue was USD 9.56 billion, adjusted diluted EPS was USD 4.24, RPO was USD 33.6 billion, and total backlog was USD 53.4 billion.
summary: Quanta's SEC-filed Q2 release reports record revenue, earnings, cash flow, RPO and backlog and raises 2026 adjusted diluted-EPS guidance to USD 16.45-16.95 and free-cash-flow guidance to USD 2.00-2.50 billion.
